title: Mother and Son Formal Portrait, 1946 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Black and white snapshot taken in August 1946 depicting a stylishly dressed mother and her young son posing outdoors on a residential lawn. The mother wears a mid-1940s dark skirt suit with a white blouse and light-colored hat, while the young boy stands beside her in a dark suit complete with a pocket square. A residential neighborhood street with trees and houses is visible in the background, offering a glimpse into post-WWII American suburban family life.
